about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Tesla
about.summary: American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce elektromobilů, bateriových úložišť a solárních systémů.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things, domain security, videoconferencing, and ener
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro výrobu čipů, hlavně pro leptání a nanášení vrstev.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává zařízení, služby a software pro výrobu čipů, displejů a solárních panelů.

about.label: Costco
about.summary: American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec velkoobchodních prodejen, do kterých se nakupuje s členskou kartou.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: Netflix, Inc.
about.summary: American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios and the Albuquerque Studios.
about.summary_cs: Americká streamovací služba s filmy a seriály, která sama vyrábí velkou část svého obsahu.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: KLA Corporation
about.summary: American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fab equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro kontrolu a měření čipů při jejich výrobě.

about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce analogových čipů a procesorů pro průmysl a auta.

about.label: Marvell Technology
about.summary: American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro datová centra, sítě a ukládání dat.

about.label: Amgen
about.summary: American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. The company's major products are Prolia and XGEVA to treat osteoporosis and bone diseases, Repatha to treat hyperlipidemia, Otezla to treat psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, Enbrel to treat autoimmune diseases, Evenity to treat osteoporosis, Tepezza to treat Graves'
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, jejíž hlavní léky léčí osteoporózu, vysoký cholesterol, lupénku a autoimunitní onemocnění.

about.label: Linde Group
about.summary: Global multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier by market share and revenue.
about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní chemická firma, největší dodavatel průmyslových plynů na světě.

about.label: Seagate Technology
about.summary: Irish-domiciled data storage company. Since 2010, the company has been incorporated in Dublin, Ireland, with operational headquarters in Fremont, California, United States.
about.summary_cs: Americko-irský výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: T-Mobile US
about.summary: American wireless network operator headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.
about.summary_cs: Americký mobilní operátor, jeden ze tří největších v USA.

about.label: PepsiCo
about.summary: American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York, in the hamlet of Purchase. PepsiCo's business encompasses all aspects of the food and beverage market.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů a snacků se značkami Pepsi, Lay's, Doritos a Gatorade.
